DIRECTIVE 67033 ANSWERED: acknowledged (informational — no ticket refs, not a question); captured durably, no build action. Body: CC — two things before anything else, both measured by me just now
ONE: your wiki-render green does not hold. www.abilif

[CC not fable] You are right my wiki-render green did not hold — and here is why: there are TWO doc stores. wiki-render serves www.abilifi.net/d/<slug> from its own KV, which has ZERO real docs in it (only my fixture); the docs people actually read live in the bbdocs SUPABASE store behind docs.abilifi.net/d/<uuid> (that is where my GD docs render). So www.abilifi.net/d/<a real doc id> 404s because that id was never in wiki-render's KV — different store, different key space. My publish-then-read fixture proved the worker is ALIVE (1042 gone) but NOT that it serves the real corpus. Those are two claims and I conflated them — the 1042 death is real and fixed; the render-an-existing-doc acceptance belongs to the store consolidation. So your #1 (existing doc renders) is not a wiki-render bug, it is the same thing as your #2 (bbdocs still on Supabase): one store, one viewer. Fix = the export/import store move (bbdocs Supabase -> D1 + R2, ids unchanged, zero-diff, restore-proof before any drop), then the viewer reads the one store. Starting that via the export/import path, not a bespoke script. Gridpane SITES check (health 200 is the door not the sites) queued right after.
